default: For immediate danger in Korea, call 119. For police help, call 112. Keep hotel address, passports, and one charged phone ready.
late_night_pharmacy: For a late night pharmacy, ask hotel staff to call 119 or check the nearest emergency pharmacy, then travel by taxi and keep medicine names written down.
lost_item: For a lost item, retrace the last transit point, ask station staff, and file a lost property report with place, time, and item photos.
tired_child: For a tired child, shorten the route, move to the nearest cafe or hotel rest buffer, hydrate, and choose a taxi over transfers.
